sources: onsemi 1N91x, 1N4x48, FDLL914, FDLL4x48 Small Signal Diode, 1N914/D Rev. 6 (September 2024), from onsemi https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/1n914-d.pdf, read 2026-10-31; LCSC C96325 is onsemi 1N914, DO-35 (JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31 (edakit part search): Extended Part, no stock; LCSC's copy of the data sheet is the older Fairchild Rev. 2.8)

vr_max_v 100: p. 2 maximum repetitive reverse voltage VRRM; if_max_a 0.3: DC forward current IF (IO 200 mA average rectified, 400 mA recurrent peak); ifsm_max_a 1.0: non-repetitive surge at 1.0 s (4.0 A at 1 ms); tj_max_c 175, t_min_c −55: operating junction temperature
p_max_w 0.5 and rth_ja_k_per_w 300: p. 2 thermal characteristics PD, RθJA

vf_v 1.0 at vf_at_a 0.01: p. 2 VF maximum of the 1N914 at IF = 10 mA; ir_a 25 nA at 20 V: p. 2 IR maximum (printed 0.025 with the micro sign of the PDF's font; 50 at 150 °C – µA, as Figure 2's nA scale shows)

spice: assumption – IS, N, RS fitted by Claude to the typical curves, no manufacturer model read: Figure 4 (VF 500 mV at 0.1 mA, 620 mV at 1 mA, 735 mV at 10 mA, read from the graph) gives N 1.97 and IS 5.2 nA; Figure 5 (0.92 V at 100 mA, 1.45 V at 800 mA, read from the graph) RS 0.65 Ω; BV 100 V at 100 µA (p. 2 breakdown voltage); CJO 4 pF (p. 2 total capacitance maximum of the 914)
notes: Small-signal silicon diode, DO-35: the clipping diodes of the Tubescreamer and the Rat. Library draft.
